content: If you want a decent pair of noise-canceling earbuds without spending a fortune, Nothing’s Ear 3A are worth considering. The wireless earbuds offer a lot of features for the price, and they’re an even better value now that all four colors are on sale at Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy for $79 ($20 off), matching their all-time low price. [Product: Nothing Ear 3A earbuds | https://www.amazon.com/Nothing-Ear-3a-Cancelling-Recording/dp/B0GZW1BYJF/?th=1&tag=theverge02-20, https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2F1234567890%2F20138215272, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fnothing-ear-3a-wireless-bluetooth-in-ear-earbuds-white%2FCZTTGJQH7G%2Fsku%2F6686088] The Ear 3A deliver great performance for the price, with extensive EQ options that let you fine-tune the sound to your liking. My colleague John Higgins found the default sound a little too bass-heavy, but appreciated how easy it was to adjust — which is great, since that level of customization is unusual for earbuds at this price. While they won’t completely drown out chatter of your local coffee shop, the ANC does a good job of quieting low drones, including air conditioners and airplane cabin noise. We did encounter some bugs in testing, however, including abrupt changes in noise cancellation levels when using adaptive ANC, as well as occasional issues with voice calls in noisy environments. Still, they’re relatively minor drawbacks given what you get for the price. The Ear 3A also come in some fun colors — including a striking pink shade — and each pair includes extra-small ear tips for a more comfortable fit. They even offer a shortcut to access ChatGPT and include 32MB of built-in storage, letting you record up to two hours of a phone call and transfer the recording through the companion app. Read our Nothing Ear 3A review.

chineseContent: 如果你想要一副像样的降噪耳机，又不想花太多钱，Nothing's Ear 3A值得考虑。这款无线耳机在价格上提供了很多功能，而且现在它们的价值更高，所有四种颜色都在亚马逊、沃尔玛和百思买上以 79 美元（折扣 20 美元）的价格出售，与它们的历史低价相匹配。 【产品：Nothing Ear 3A耳塞 | https://www.amazon.com/Nothing-Ear-3a-Cancelling-Recording/dp/B0GZW1BYJF/?th=1&tag=theverge02-20， https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2F1234567890%2F20138215272， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fnothing-ear-3a-wireless-bluetooth-in-ear-earbuds-white%2FCZTTGJQH7G%2Fsku%2F6686088] Ear 3A 提供出色的性能物超所值，具有丰富的 EQ 选项，可让您根据自己的喜好微调声音。我的同事约翰·希金斯 (John Higgins) 发现默认声音有点太重低音，但很欣赏它的调节方式是多么容易——这很好，因为这种程度的定制对于这个价格的耳塞来说是不寻常的。虽然 ANC 不会完全淹没当地咖啡店的喧闹声，但它可以很好地消除低空无人机的噪音，包括空调和机舱噪音。然而，我们在测试中确实遇到了一些错误，包括使用自适应 ANC 时噪音消除级别的突然变化，以及在嘈杂环境中语音通话的偶尔问题。不过，考虑到你所得到的价格，它们的缺点相对较小。 Ear 3A 还提供一些有趣的颜色，包括引人注目的粉色，每副耳机都配有超小耳塞，佩戴更舒适。它们甚至提供了访问 ChatGPT 的快捷方式，并包含 32MB 内置存储空间，让您最多可以记录两段内容
